recognize_zh: 緊密排列的芽細胞群，核圓至不規則、部分有切跡或凹陷，染色質細緻、細胞質極少且無顆粒，其間散在幾顆小而深染的成熟淋巴球可作大小比較，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Densely packed intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to irregular, notched or convoluted nuclear contours
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Scattered small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin and a few crushed/smudged cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratios and scant agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to irregular with frequent notches and convolutions, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered small mature lymphocytes and occasional crushed cells are present, while normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, pending immunophenotypic lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: Convoluted nuclei are sometimes associated with T-ALL but are not lineage-specific; cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a by flow is required.
Cells may have irregular nuclei but are TdT-negative, CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with surface light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Separated by MPO or myeloid antigen expression by flow cytometry.
Show homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal maturational B-cell pattern, usually as a minor population.
